# SolarBidDesk
> Free public directory of US published tenders (California, Texas, New York) for solar PV, battery storage and EV chargers, with installer/EPC fit scores and official source links. Free weekly digest; Pro adds reasons, CSV and daily delta. Contact: info@solarbiddesk.com

## Key pages
- [Tender directory](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/tenders/)
- State hubs: [California](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/ca/), [Texas](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/tx/), [New York](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/ny/)
- Tender pages: https://solarbiddesk.com/us/tenders/<slug>/
- [Home, free digest and Pro](https://solarbiddesk.com/)

## Data (public-notice fields + scores)
- [tenders.csv](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/data/tenders.csv)
- [tenders.json](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/data/tenders.json)
- Sources: NYS Contract Reporter, Texas ESBD / SmartBuy, PlanetBids agency portals, Caltrans CCOP; SAM.gov when API keyed. Scores are screening aids, not bid advice.

## Guides
- [How to find public solar tenders in the US](https://solarbiddesk.com/guides/how-to-find-public-solar-tenders-us/)

## Notes
- Primary CTA is the free weekly digest; Pro is optional.
- Directory listings are free and cite the issuing agency notice.
- Sister product: PowerDealDesk (Australian NEM battery project directory).
- Last updated 2026-10-26.
